description: Create and validate a governed managed implementation plan from TRD-20260904-2D10A556 for the Sys4AI depot root, the exact template project, and the independent Memory Service product, while preserving unrelated work and performing no planned implementation.
definition_of_done: A distinct project-local Task records this planning-only objective and links it to the completed requirements-definition Task without changing either unrelated nonterminal Task.

The exact regular non-symlink TRD source is inspected with its SHA-256 digest, and all 24 settled requirements, decisions, exclusions, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and authority boundaries are represented without changing the TRD.

A managed draft implementation plan under Implementation_Plans maps every source requirement forward to bounded work and every task back to a requirement or explicit design basis, with ordered phases, dependencies, risks, protected paths, acceptance criteria, planned checks, and completion evidence needs grounded in the live depot, template, and Memory Service.

The plan helper successfully creates the canonical plan and deterministic projections; an exact show and selected-plan validation confirm canonical integrity, bidirectional coverage, projection agreement, and catalog-index agreement without unresolved structural errors.

No implementation task is started and no skill adoption, dependency installation, Memory System initialization, provider/model activation, destructive action, Git operation, publication, deployment, or external communication occurs under this planning Task.
current_summary: TASK-20260904-D252517F is complete. Managed plan PLAN-20260904-7AEB452E revision 1 is a structurally valid draft with 24 active requirements, 8 planned phases, 29 planned tasks, complete bidirectional coverage, current projections, and a current catalog index. It has not been approved as ready or authorized for implementation. One unintended user-wide Cognee log created during read-only package probing remains untouched and is recorded as baseline evidence.
